description: A quarter with one full update, a write-off, a down round, a company with nothing new (and an old stored update), a confidential update, and a net figure the administrator has not reported yet.

brief.instructions: Write the Q2 2026 letter for Example Fund II in the general voice.
basis_notes: Gross figures are the performance report's, for the total portfolio, as of 2026-06-30.
Net figures are the fund administrator's, as recorded in Hemrock, as of 2026-06-30.

updates_this_quarter.subject: Lattice Freight Q2 2026 update
updates_this_quarter.text: Q2 was our strongest quarter. ARR reached $4.1M at June 30, up from $3.2M at March 31. We added 11 new shipper customers, for 58 in total, and opened our second dispatch hub in the Midwest. Gross margin was 61% for the quarter. We are hiring a VP of Sales and expect to start the search in August.

updates_this_quarter.subject: CONFIDENTIAL - Lattice board pipeline notes
updates_this_quarter.text: Confidential, not for distribution. We are in late-stage talks with a national grocery chain on a three-year contract worth roughly $1.8M a year, and pricing is set at a 14 percent discount to our list rate to win it.

companies.stored_business_update: Lattice Freight runs a dispatch network for regional shippers.

events: Written off on 2026-05-31: the company wound down after its lead program failed a safety study. The fund's $750,000 investment is now carried at $0.
Down round on 2026-04-22: Saltmarsh raised a $6M Series A extension at a lower price per share than the fund's Series A. The fund's position was marked down from $1,500,000 to $900,000.

updates_this_quarter.subject: Saltmarsh Q2 update
updates_this_quarter.text: We closed the $6M extension in April. Two pilot sites are now generating revenue, and Q2 revenue was $310K. The new funding gives us runway into the second half of 2027 by our estimate.

companies.stored_business_update: Tidewater plans to launch its marine sensor network commercially in Q1 2026 and expects to sign its first three port authorities before the end of 2025.

brief.partner_notes: Lead with the write-off and the down round; don't bury them. We are comfortable with how the rest of the portfolio is tracking. No market commentary this quarter.
